proposals.title: STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING PAY EQUITY REPORT
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report identifying whether a gender pay gap exists among employees and, if so, steps being taken to reduce it.
proposals.evidence: The Board unanimously recommends a vote AGAINST adoption of Proposal No. 4.

proposals.title: STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING POLITICAL CONTRIBUTIONS REPORT
proposals.proponent: The New York State Common Retirement Fund
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a public report disclosing policies and recipients of corporate political contributions and expenditures, including trade association payments used for political purposes.
proposals.evidence: the Board of Directors unanimously recommends a vote AGAINST adoption of Proposal No. 5.

proposals.title: STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING LOBBYING REPORT
proposals.proponent: Boston Common Asset Management, LLC, with co-sponsor Walden Asset Management
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annual report disclosing direct and indirect lobbying policies, payments, model-legislation organization memberships, and board oversight.
proposals.evidence: the Board of Directors unanimously recommends a vote AGAINST adoption of Proposal No. 6.

proposals.title: STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING INDEPENDENT BOARD CHAIR
proposals.topic_summary: Requests adoption of a policy requiring the Board Chair, whenever possible, to be an independent director.
proposals.evidence: the Board unanimously recommends a vote AGAINST adoption of Proposal No. 7.
